title: Things We Said Today
lyrics_synced:
[00:05.67] You say you will love me
[00:09.45] if I have to go!
[00:13.23] You'll be thinking of me,
[00:17.01] somehow I will know!
[00:20.79] Someday when I'm lonely,
[00:24.57] wishing you weren't so far away!
[00:28.35] Then I will remember the things we said today!
[00:37.80] You say you'll be mine, girl,
[00:41.57] until the end of time!
[00:45.35] These days such a kind girl
[00:49.13] seems so hard to find!
[00:52.91] Someday when we're dreaming!
[00:56.93] Deep in love, not a lot to say!
[01:00.47] Then we will remember
[01:04.25] the things we said today!
[01:08.03] Me, I'm just the lucky kind.
[01:11.81] Love to hear you say that love is love!
[01:16.30] And, though we may be blind,
[01:19.37] love is here to stay and that's enough
[01:23.62] to make you mine, girl,
[01:26.93] be the only one.
[01:30.71] Love me all the time, girl!
[01:34.49] We'll go on and on!
[01:38.27] Someday when we're dreaming!
[01:42.05] Deep in love, not a lot to say!
[01:45.83] Then we will remember
[01:49.61] the things we said today!
[01:53.39] Love me all the time, girl!
[01:57.17] We'll go on and on!
[01:59.53] Someday when we're dreaming,
[02:04.72] deep in love, not a lot to say,
[02:08.27] then we will remember
[02:12.28] the things we said today!
[02:16.06] Love me all the time, girl!
[02:19.84] We'll go on and on!
[02:23.62] Someday when we're dreaming!
[02:27.40] Deep in love, not a lot to say!
[02:31.18] Then we will remember
[02:34.96] the things we said today!
